articles.title: 第二組：時間與天氣
articles.content:
What time is it right now?

It is ten thirty in the morning.

The weather is very sunny and hot today.

I think it is going to rain this afternoon.

My favorite season is winter because of the snow.

We usually have dinner at seven o'clock.

Don't forget to bring your umbrella.

Yesterday was a very cold and windy day.

The train will arrive in fifteen minutes.

Is it Monday or Tuesday today?

articles.title: 第三組：飲食與餐廳
articles.content:
Are you ready to order your food?

I would like a cup of hot coffee, please.

This cake tastes very sweet and delicious.

Do you prefer tea or fruit juice?

I am a vegetarian, so I don't eat meat.

Can I have the menu one more time?

We need a table for four people tonight.

Where is the nearest Italian restaurant?

I am very hungry and want to eat pizza.

The check, please. I want to pay now.

articles.title: 第四組：購物與價格
articles.content:
How much does this blue shirt cost?

It is twenty dollars after the discount.

Do you have this dress in a smaller size?

I am just looking around the store.

Can I pay with my credit card?

This supermarket is open twenty-four hours.

Where can I find the milk and eggs?

I want to buy a birthday gift for my mom.

Is there a pharmacy near the shopping mall?

That is too expensive for me to buy.

articles.title: 第五組：休閒與運動
articles.content:
I like playing basketball with my friends.

What is your favorite movie genre?

She enjoys listening to pop music every night.

Do you want to go swimming tomorrow?

I went to the cinema to see an action movie.

He plays the guitar very well.

Let's go for a walk in the park.

I love reading books before I go to sleep.

My hobby is taking beautiful photos.

Do you watch television on the weekend?

articles.title: 第六組：交通與方向
articles.content:
Go straight and turn left at the corner.

The bus station is across from the bank.

How do I get to the library from here?

It takes about ten minutes to walk there.

I usually take the subway to go to work.

Is the post office far from this hotel?

Excuse me, is this the right way to the airport?

Please drive slowly; the road is wet.

I missed the last bus home last night.

You can see the museum on your right side.

articles.title: 第七組：工作與辦公室
articles.content:
I have a very important meeting at two PM.

Please send me an email with the report.

Where did you put the blue folder?

My boss is very kind and helpful to everyone.

I need to print five copies of this document.

What is your job title at the company?

I am looking for a new job these days.

He works in the marketing department.

Can you help me fix the computer?

We have a coffee break at three o'clock.

articles.title: 第八組：家庭與居所
articles.content:
My house has three bedrooms and a kitchen.

Please close the door when you leave.

I need to clean my room this Saturday.

There is a large garden behind our house.

Who is the person in this old photo?

I forgot my keys on the dining table.

My parents live in a quiet country town.

Can you help me wash the dishes?

The living room is very bright and tidy.

We are moving to a new house next month.

articles.title: 第九組：健康與感受
articles.content:
I feel a bit tired after the long trip.

You should go to see a doctor today.

I have a headache and a sore throat.

Drink more water and get some rest.

I am very happy to hear the good news.

Why do you look so sad this morning?

Are you feeling better than you were yesterday?

I exercise every morning to stay healthy.

Don't worry, everything will be fine.

It is important to sleep eight hours a night.

articles.title: 第十組：旅遊與度假
articles.content:
I am planning a trip to Japan this summer.

Where is your passport and your ticket?

I want to stay in a hotel near the beach.

We took many photos during our vacation.

Did you book the flight for next Friday?

The mountain view is absolutely beautiful.

I like to visit historical museums.

Pack your suitcase tonight before you sleep.

What is the most famous place in this city?

I hope you have a safe and pleasant journey.
